content: Write executable pytest tests for the supplied contract. Use complete explicit argument tuples. Keep normal-return cases separate from expected-exception cases. Check expected results against concrete arguments. Follow the explicit coverage expectations; do not invent identity, nesting or bounds requirements. Distinguish inspection from execution and do not claim execution.

Function contract: ascii_upper(text).

- text: exact built-in str; reject str subclasses.

Reject invalid specified types with TypeError before shape/value checks.

Uppercase only ASCII a-z. Preserve all other characters, including non-ASCII letters.

Return type: exact built-in str.

Coverage expectations: include normal cases for empty, ascii-case, punctuation-digits, nonascii-unchanged, newline. Test each input position and each stated nested type level with an ordinary wrong type and a subclass; reject bool wherever exact int is required, holding other inputs valid. Exercise stated invalid domain/shape/bounds rules and mixed-invalid witnesses for the stated validation order. Check exact returned types at the stated levels.

Write one complete pytest file importing 'from subject import ascii_upper'. Do not implement, replace, mock or inspect the function. Use only pytest and the standard library. Use complete explicit argument tuples. Return one Python code block, then a brief requirement-to-input mapping and finite-coverage limitations. Do not claim execution.
